contributions.name: Raymarched shape
contributions.description: A sphere melting into a rounded box over a checkered floor, found by sphere tracing and lit with soft shadows. Distance functions live in an included file.
notes: A signed distance function says how far a point is from the surface; sphere tracing steps along each ray by that distance.
The normal is the gradient of the distance, taken by central differences.
A smooth union blends two shapes; Blend sets how far the melt reaches.
sdf.glsl is a file the Image pass pulls in with #include.

contributions.name: Procedural particles
contributions.description: Glowing particles rising and swaying, drawn in a single Image pass with no stored state: each one's position is a function of its index and the time.
notes: A hash turns a particle's index into stable random numbers: its lifetime, start and colour.
GLSL loops need a constant bound, so the Particles control stops the loop early instead.
Light is added up, then mapped back below 1 so bright overlaps do not clip.

contributions.name: Feedback trails
contributions.description: Buffer A reads the frame it drew last tick, fades it and paints a moving brush on top; the Image pass displays the trail. Press on the canvas to paint with the pointer.
notes: iChannel0 of Buffer A is bound to Buffer A itself with feedback: last tick's frame, not this one's.
A buffer starts out all zeros; every written texel has alpha 1, so alpha 0 means start clean.
Clear wipes the trail while it is on.
The Image pass samples Buffer A without feedback: the frame drawn this tick.

contributions.name: Interactive UI
contributions.description: A slider and a switch drawn with distance functions and driven by the pointer. Buffer A remembers their state from one frame to the next; the Common pass holds the layout both passes share.
notes: iMouse holds the pointer in pixels; its z is above 0 while a button is pressed.
A shader has no variables that last, so Buffer A stores the UI state and reads it back with feedback.
The switch flips only on the frame a press starts, by remembering whether the pointer was down.
Code in the Common pass is shared by every pass.
